name: Graveyard P/T counts read every form
notes: Counts that gave nothing, the wrong number or asked for a typed X. Your graveyard: Craw Wurm (6/4, mana value 6), Diligent Farmhand, Llanowar Elves, Shock, Divination, Muscle Burst, Ancestral Anger, Kjeldoran War Cry (five instant and sorcery cards, noncreature nonland too; greatest power 6, greatest mana value 6). You own Lightning Bolt and Think Twice in exile. The opponent's graveyard: Grizzly Bears, Forest, Ornithopter (creature, land, artifact; one green creature card). Monstrous War-Leech 6/6; Crackling Drake 7/4 (5 + 2 in exile); Dragonfly Swarm 5/3; Haunting Apparition, the opponent chosen, 1 + 1 = 2/2; Nighthawk Scavenger 1 + 3 = 4/3; Carrion Grub 0+6 = 6/5; Coram 6/5. Haunting Apparition's player list is the opponents ("choose an opponent").

scryfallData.name: Monstrous War-Leech
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Kicker {U} (You may pay an additional {U} as you cast this spell.)
As this creature enters, if it was kicked, mill four cards. (To mill a card, put the top card of your library into your graveyard.)
Monstrous War-Leech's power and toughness are each equal to the greatest mana value among cards in your graveyard.

scryfallData.name: Crackling Drake
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Flying
Crackling Drake's power is equal to the total number of instant and sorcery cards you own in exile and in your graveyard.
When this creature enters, draw a card.

scryfallData.name: Dragonfly Swarm
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Flying, ward {1} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {1}.)
This creature's power is equal to the number of noncreature, nonland cards in your graveyard.
When this creature dies, if there's a Lesson card in your graveyard, draw a card.

scryfallData.name: Haunting Apparition
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Flying
As this creature enters, choose an opponent.
Haunting Apparition's power is equal to 1 plus the number of green creature cards in the chosen player's graveyard.
scryfallData.flavor_text: Like some foul herdbeast, it grazes on the dead.

scryfallData.name: Nighthawk Scavenger
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Flying, deathtouch, lifelink
Nighthawk Scavenger's power is equal to 1 plus the number of card types among cards in your opponents' graveyards.
scryfallData.flavor_text: Under Drana's leadership, vampires are finding new strength in unity.

scryfallData.name: Carrion Grub
scryfallData.oracle_text:
This creature gets +X/+0, where X is the greatest power among creature cards in your graveyard.
When this creature enters, mill four cards. (Put the top four cards of your library into your graveyard.)

scryfallData.name: Coram, the Undertaker
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Coram gets +X/+0, where X is the greatest power among creature cards in all graveyards.
Whenever Coram attacks, each player mills a card.
During each of your turns, you may play a land and cast a spell from among cards in graveyards that were put there from libraries this turn.

graveyard.name: Craw Wurm
graveyard.flavor_text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

graveyard.name: Diligent Farmhand
graveyard.oracle_text:
{1}{G}, Sacrifice this creature: Search your library for a basic land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
If this card is in a graveyard, effects from spells named Muscle Burst count it as a card named Muscle Burst.

graveyard.name: Llanowar Elves
graveyard.flavor_text: The elves of the Llanowar forest have defended it for generations. It is their sacred duty to keep outside influences from corrupting their ancestral home.

graveyard.name: Shock
graveyard.oracle_text: Shock deals 2 damage to any target.
graveyard.flavor_text: If you're going to have a gimmick, embrace it.

graveyard.name: Divination
graveyard.flavor_text: "The stars mark your destiny. May you accept the fate thus divulged."

graveyard.name: Muscle Burst
graveyard.oracle_text: Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is 3 plus the number of cards named Muscle Burst in all graveyards.
graveyard.flavor_text: As strong as a centaur's will.

graveyard.name: Ancestral Anger
graveyard.oracle_text:
Target creature gains trample and gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is 1 plus the number of cards named Ancestral Anger in your graveyard.
Draw a card.
graveyard.flavor_text: An incautious Lorehold student may learn more about the unbound rage of the Blood Age than they wanted to.

graveyard.name: Kjeldoran War Cry
graveyard.oracle_text: Creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is 1 plus the number of cards named Kjeldoran War Cry in all graveyards.
graveyard.flavor_text: King Darien's breath crystallized and fell to the frozen battlefield, but its command carried true to all soldiers of New Argive.

graveyard.name: Grizzly Bears
graveyard.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

graveyard.name: Forest
graveyard.flavor_text:
"You have only one mission, minions: protect me with your lives. In order to do this, you need to wear down Captain Britain's psyche. In order to do *that*, you need to burn down her precious lands. Am I understood?"
—Morgan Le Fay

graveyard.name: Ornithopter
graveyard.flavor_text:
"It has been my honor to improve on Thran's original design. Perhaps history will remember me in some small part for my work."
—Urza, in his apprenticeship

card.name: Lightning Bolt
card.oracle_text: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.
card.flavor_text: "I am the god of thunder, the lord of the savage lightning, and the very skies must tremble when speaks The Mighty Thor!"

card.name: Think Twice
card.oracle_text:
Draw a card.
Flashback {2}{U} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
card.flavor_text:
"You have long tried to eliminate me from your timeline, Kang. And yet I remain. We are forever bound. We are one."
—Immortus
